summary: Seanergy Maritime Holdings Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release reporting Q1 2026 financial results and declaring an $0.20-per-share quarterly cash dividend, its 18th consecutive distribution under an ongoing capital return policy. Cumulative distributions total approximately $2.84 per share ($55.6 million) since inception. The filing also disclosed a fleet renewal program: six newbuildings for ~$460 million, the sale of a 2010-built Capesize for $29.5 million (net liquidity ~$13.4 million), and ~$237 million in new debt financings. The capital return component is the repeat dividend declaration, not the newbuild or vessel sale. Watch for continued quarterly dividend consistency and any shift in payout ratio.
